items.title: Hellenic DPA fines Teleperformance Greece EUR 100 000 for GDPR breaches
items.description: Background information Date of final decision: 05/10/2026 National case Controller: TELEPERFORMANCE GREECE Legal References: Articles 5 (Principles relating to processing of personal data), 12 (Transparent information, communication and modalities for the exercise of the rights of the data subject), 13 (Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject), 15 (Right of access by the data subject), 17 (Right to erasure (‘right to be forgotten’)), and 32 (Security of processing) Decision: Administrative fine Key words: Fines Summary of the Decision Origin of the case A former employee of TELEPERFORMANCE GREECE lodged a complaint against the company for failing to comply with his request to exercise his right of access to personal data concerning him, in violation of Article 15 of the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR). Key Findings Following the complaint lodged by the former employee of TELEPERFORMANCE GREECE, the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (HDPA) found multiple violations of the GDPR.
